title: P&P CHEF Colander Strainer Stainless Steel 3 Quart, Metal Micro-Perforated Colander for Kitchen Food, Ideal for Rinsing Washing Draining, Dishwasher Safe, Shiny Silver
description:
About this item
【Healthy & Food-grade】 P&P CHEF colander is constructed by premium stainless steel, No any toxic substances or coatings leaching into food, Odourless and rust proof, Not react with your food, Sturdy materials and reinforced construction ensures its durability and be unbreakable, rather than the silicone or plastic bowl, Healthy for long-term use
【Micro-Perforated】 Small and close holes are evenly distributed throughout the colander, Prevent small food falling through and achieve fast drainage, Heat-proof stainless steel construction allows it draining hot food without warping, Saving much time on food preparation
【Superior Design】 Double handles are firmly welded the wide edge of the top, For a balanced and comfortable grip, Triple feet keep the colander stably without tipping over, Lifting it up about 0.4-inch height, Add one more sides to drain water for fast drainage when the bowl sitting, Won’t leave your food sitting in a puddle, To free your hand
【Multipurpose】This colander is great for washing, rinsing, draining, Greatly used for pasta, spaghetti,vegetable, fruit, meat, seafood, Also can be used as fruit container and salad mixing bowl, The 3 quart capacity is suitable for 1-2 people use in small kitchen, It would be a necessity and great helper if you need to cook
【Easy to Use & Clean】Whether grip strainer up from water or wash food under water, Choose your preferred usage, It is a great alternative to handheld spider strainer, U-handles could hang on the hook to save your storage space, Mirror finished surface made the bowl release food easily, Easy to clean in a breeze, Also dishwasher safe to save your time
